responsibility: This file implements GCC’s global string and identifier pool. It owns the identifier hash table, interns identifier text into unique IDENTIFIER_NODE objects, allocates immutable string storage in GC memory, supports lookup with or without insertion, and integrates the identifier table with GGC marking, purging, and PCH save/restore. Its responsibility is canonical storage and lifecycle management for identifier names and pooled strings shared across the compiler’s tree infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/stringpool.h, which only exposes the identifier lookup API and macro wrapper, this .cc file owns the actual global identifier hash table (ident_hash) and implements interning, GC/PCH support, statistics, and string allocation for the pool.
